title: People's Rally in Naga Areas Demands Resolution of Manipur Crisis, Withdrawal of Assam Rifles
summary: A people's rally organised by TNL and Tangkhul frontal organisations under UNC in Naga-inhabited areas of Manipur raises three demands, including resolution of the crisis and withdrawal of Assam Rifles.
body:
IMPHAL, November 5, 2026: A people's rally was held across Naga-inhabited areas of Manipur on Thursday, demanding that the Government of India take concrete steps to resolve the ongoing political crisis in the state.

The rally was organised by the Tangkhul Naga Long (TNL) and Tangkhul frontal organisations under the aegis of the United Naga Council (UNC).

**Three Key Demands Raised**

During the rally, participants raised three major demands:

-Resolution of the ongoing political crisis in Manipur by the Government of India.

-An end to what the organisers described as a proxy war in Manipur.

-Withdrawal of the Assam Rifles from Naga-inhabited areas.

The organisers urged the Centre to take concrete measures to address the political and security concerns raised by the Naga community.

The rally highlighted the organisations' demands for a political resolution and changes to the security arrangements in Naga areas of Manipur.
